title: 고등교육기관의 자체평가에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130323:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum to the Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Education and Its Affiliated Institutions <Ordinance No. 1, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. [Proviso omitted.]

Articles 2 through 6
Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) Omitted.
(2) Part of the Rules on Self-Evaluation of Higher Education Institutions shall be amended as follows:
In Article 6, "Minister of Education, Science and Technology" shall be replaced with "Minister of Education".
(3) through (61) Omitted.
